usage.callShape: GET https://x402.coinstats.app/news/{id} where {id} is a CoinStats article hash (64-char hex), e.g. https://x402.coinstats.app/news/376f390df50a1d44cb5593c9bff6faafabed18ee90e0d4d737d3b6d3eea50c80
usage.outputShape: body.title, body.source, body.link, body.description, body.feedDate (ms unix), body.imgUrl, body.relatedCoins[], body.coins[], body.shareURL
quirks: The registry surface URL https://x402.coinstats.app/news/1 is WRONG — id=1 is not a valid article and returns HTTP 400 'News article not found.' (you still get charged $0.001). The {id} path segment must be a real CoinStats article hash, a 64-char hex string, NOT a sequential integer.
You need a valid article id first (obtain it from a CoinStats news-list endpoint or a shareURL). This single-article lookup endpoint cannot be called blind without a real id.
feedDate is a Unix timestamp in MILLISECONDS.
txHash came back null on the x402 settlement but the call succeeded and was paid; confirmed=false from qa-pay.
usage.guide: This is a paid (x402, $0.001 USDC on Base) crypto-news article lookup by ID. Call GET https://x402.coinstats.app/news/{id} where {id} is a real CoinStats article hash (a 64-char hex string), NOT the registry's example /news/1 which returns a 400 'not found' and still charges you. Read the article from the top-level JSON: body.title, body.source, body.link, body.description, body.imgUrl, and body.feedDate (Unix ms). Obtain a valid article id from a CoinStats news-list call or a shareURL before invoking this endpoint, since it cannot be called blind.
